VALink is a linker that has been floating around for ages. It is showing its age quite well. There exists an Enhnaced VALink that needs a review!

  • Pros
    • Its free
    • Supports makeing DOS/EXE files.
  • Cons
    • Can ONLY handle 16bit code.
